value.rationale: The full distribution of optimal complete envy-free welfare is a natural allocation invariant. Its equivalence in probability to a classical singleton occupancy count despite demand-set overlaps supplies a quantitative answer for a many-agent, fully allocated, nontrivial complementarity regime. This is modest, and does not claim general fair-division or occupancy novelty.
